# Load packages & set variables

```{r}
#| label: load packages
#| message: false # removes tidyverse loader & here location for privacy
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(labelled)
library(here)

source(here("functions", "set_env-variables.R"))
source(file.path(PATH_FUNCTIONS, "load_functions.R"))
```


# Initialize index dataset

```{r}
#| label: index dataset load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

index_df_raw <- load_index_df(replace_with_label = c("corigin"), release = "41")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "phrf", # weighting factor
  "psample", # sample number
  "netto", # survey status
  "gebjahr", # birth year
  "gebmonat", # birth month
  "todjahr", # death year
  "partner", # relationship status
  "sampreg", # housing in east/west germany
  "migback", # has migration background
  "germborn", # born in germany
  "immiyear" # year of immigration
)


# transform
index_df <- index_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(hid, pid, syear, parid, sex, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # transform scales
  mutate(
    hid = hid %>% missing_to_na(),
    weight = phrf,
    survey_sample = psample,
    survey_status = netto,
    age = syear - (gebjahr %>%
      missing_to_na() %>%
      replace(. < 1900, NA)),
    death_year = todjahr %>% missing_to_na(),
    sex = sex %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ "male", 2 ~ "female"),
    parid = parid %>% missing_to_na(),
    partnership_status = partner %>%
      remap_values(
        0 ~ "no partner",
        1 ~ "spouse/registered partner",
        2 ~ "non-registered partner",
        3 ~ "spouse/registered partner",
        4 ~ "non-registered partner",
        5 ~ NA
      ),
    housing_east_west = sampreg %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ "West Germany", 2 ~ "East Germany"),
    migration_background = migback %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ "none", 2 ~ "direct", 3 ~ "indirect"),
    born_germany = germborn %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE),
    migration_age = ifelse(immiyear %in% c(-1, -2), # set migration age to 0 for those who have not immigrated
      0,
      immiyear - (syear - age)
    )
  ) %>%
  # additional composite variables
  mutate() %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# export & free memory
save_clean_df(index_df, "ppathl")
rm(index_df_raw, index_df, colnames_raw)
```


# Prepare Cleaned Joinable Datasets

## personal file (pl)

```{r}
#| label: personal file load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# import
personal_df_raw <- load_raw_df("pl")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "plh0339", # depression phq4-1
  "plh0340", # depression phq4-2
  "plh0341", # anxiety phq4-3
  "plh0342", # anxiety phq4-4
  "ple0019_v1", # depression ever diagnosed
  "plc0014_h", # individual net income
  "plj0175", # birthcountry parents
  "plj0048_v2", # origin_based discrimination
  "plh0175", # satisfaction household income
  "plm0565i11", # domestic violence attitiude
  "pli0092_h", # frequency sport
  "pli0059", # sleep quantity weekday
  "pli0060", # sleep quantity weekend
  "plh0172", # sleep satisfaction
  "ple0011_v1", # sleep disorder
  "ple0081_h", # smoker
  "ple0177", # alcohol consumption
  "pli0051", # hobbies weekday
  "pli0036", # hobbies saturday
  "pli0010", # hobbies sunday
  "plh0189", # feels lonely
  "plj0588", # feels left out
  "plj0589", # feels isolated
  "plh0182", # life satisfaction
  "pli0080", # how often neighbors & friends
  "plh0173", # job satisfaction
  "plb0478_v1", # job change
  "plb0193_v1", # ever work overtime
  "plb0197", # hours overtime last month
  "plb0206_v2", # work nights
  "plh0176", # satisfaction personal income
  "plh0226", # impact of stress
  "ple0036", # chronically ill
  "ple0016_v1", # stroke
  "ple0007", # weight
  "ple0006", # height
  "ple0041_h", # degree of disability
  "ple0008", # current health description
  "plh0171", # current health satisfaction
  "plh0206i11", # positive attitude towards oneself
  "plh0216", # Worry a lot
  "plh0221", # somewhat nervous
  "plh0214", # sometimes too coarse with others
  "plh0206i08", # think about experienced injustice very long
  "plh0244", # pessimism
  "plh0381_v2", # perceived control over life
  "plh0379_v2", # life course depends on me
  "plh0386_v2" # low control about important things
)

# selecting raw variables
personal_df <- personal_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(pid, syear, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # group by pid so there's never any spillover
  group_by(pid) %>%
  arrange(pid, syear) %>%
  # depression
  mutate(
    ## depression phq-4
    plh0339 = if_else(plh0339 >= 0, plh0339 - 1, NA),
    plh0340 = if_else(plh0340 >= 0, plh0340 - 1, NA),
    depression_phq4_score = plh0339 + plh0340,
    depression_phq4_binary = depression_phq4_score >= 3,
    ## depression diagnosed
    depression_diagnosed = ple0019_v1 %>%
      remap_values(-2 ~ FALSE, -1 ~ FALSE, 1 ~ TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ## leads of depression variables (see cleaning_helpers for info)
  add_temporal_shift_columns(shift_by = 1, colname_pattern = "^depression") %>%
  ## remove non-lead versions
  select(-matches("depression_(?!.*1y).*", perl = TRUE)) %>%
  # immigration
  mutate(
    ## child of immigrants
    born_germany_parents = plj0175 %>% remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE),
    discrimination = plj0048_v2 %>% remap_values(
      1 ~ "often",
      2 ~ "rarely",
      3 ~ "never",
      -2 ~ "never",
      factor_ordered = TRUE
    )
  ) %>%
  # income
  mutate(
    income_net_individual = plc0014_h %>% missing_to_na(),
    income_satisfied_household = plh0175 %>% missing_to_na(),
    income_satisfied_individual = plh0176 %>% missing_to_na()
  ) %>%
  # physical health
  mutate(
    height_m = (ple0006 %>% missing_to_na()) / 100,
    height_m = ifelse(height_m >= 0.54 &
      height_m <= 2.72, height_m, NA),
    # limits based on shortest and tallest adult in world history
    weight_kg = ple0007 %>% missing_to_na(),
    weight_kg = ifelse(weight_kg >= 2.13 &
      weight_kg <= 635, weight_kg, NA),
    # limits based on lightest and heaviest adult in world history
    bmi = (weight_kg) / (height_m^2),
    obese = bmi >= 30,
    sports_frequency = pli0092_h %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "daily",
        2 ~ "weekly",
        3 ~ "monthly",
        4 ~ "less than once a month",
        5 ~ "never",
        6 ~ "never",
        8 ~ NA,
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    sleep_hours_weekly = (pli0059 %>% missing_to_na()) * 5 +
      (pli0060 %>% missing_to_na()) * 2,
    sleep_quality = plh0172 %>% missing_to_na(),
    sleep_disorder = ple0011_v1 %>% remap_values(
      1 ~ TRUE,
      -2 ~ FALSE
    ),
    smoker = ple0081_h %>% remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE),
    alcohol_frequency = ple0177 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "daily",
        2 ~ "4-6 days a week",
        3 ~ "2-3 days a week",
        4 ~ "2-4 days a month",
        5 ~ "once a month or less",
        6 ~ "never",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    chronic_illness = ple0036 %>% remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE),
    disability_degree = ple0041_h %>% remap_values(
      -2 ~ 0,
      require_full_remap = FALSE,
      warn_on_partial_remap = FALSE
    ),
    stroke_ever = ple0016_v1 %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, -2 ~ FALSE),
    health_description = ple0008 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "very good",
        2 ~ "good",
        3 ~ "satisfactory",
        4 ~ "less good",
        5 ~ "poor",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    health_satisfaction = plh0171 %>% missing_to_na()
  ) %>%
  # mental health & qol
  mutate(
    stress_deal_well = plh0226 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    hobbies_hours_weekly = pli0051 %>% missing_to_na() * 5 +
      pli0036 %>% missing_to_na() +
      pli0010 %>% missing_to_na(),
    friends_frequency = pli0080 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "daily",
        2 ~ "weekly",
        3 ~ "monthly",
        4 ~ "seldom",
        5 ~ "never",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    life_satisfaction = plh0182 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    eval_self_positive = plh0206i11 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    feels_lonely = plh0189 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "agree completely",
        2 ~ "agree",
        3 ~ "disagree",
        4 ~ "disagree completely",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    feels_left_out = plj0588 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "very often",
        2 ~ "often",
        3 ~ "sometimes",
        4 ~ "seldom",
        5 ~ "never",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    feels_isolated = plj0589 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "very often",
        2 ~ "often",
        3 ~ "sometimes",
        4 ~ "seldom",
        5 ~ "never",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    character_worrying = plh0216 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    character_nervous = plh0221 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    character_irritable = plh0214 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    character_rumination = plh0206i08 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    character_optimism = plh0244 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "optimistic",
        2 ~ "somewhat optimistic",
        3 ~ "somewhat pessimistic",
        4 ~ "pessimistic",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    belief_others_control_life = plh0381_v2 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    belief_self_shapes_destiny = plh0379_v2 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1),
    belief_little_control_life = plh0386_v2 %>%
      missing_to_na() %>% decrement_by(1)
  ) %>%
  # work
  mutate(
    job_satisfaction = plh0173 %>% missing_to_na(),
    # 10 step likert scale
    job_changed = plb0478_v1 %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ TRUE, -2 ~ FALSE),
    # helper variable for grouping
    job_nr_individual = job_changed %>%
      replace_na(FALSE) %>%
      cumsum() %>%
      decrement_by(-1),
    # increment by 1 so it starts at 1
    overtime_ever = plb0193_v1 %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE, 3 ~ NA),
    overtime_hours_month = plb0197 %>% remap_values(
      -2 ~ 0,
      require_full_remap = FALSE,
      warn_on_partial_remap = FALSE
    ),
    work_nights = plb0206_v2 %>%
      remap_values(
        2 ~ "every day",
        3 ~ "several times a week",
        4 ~ "on weekly basis",
        5 ~ "rarely",
        1 ~ "never",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  # ungroup
  ungroup() %>%
  # add static "data present" variable for tracking
  mutate(data_personal = TRUE) %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# separate partner_violence_df
partner_violence_risk_df <- personal_df_raw %>%
  select(pid, syear, plm0565i11) %>%
  mutate(partner_violence_risk = plm0565i11 %>% missing_to_na()) %>%
  select(-plm0565i11)


# export & free memory
save_clean_df(personal_df, "pl")
save_clean_df(partner_violence_risk_df, "pvr", ignore_no_raw_equivalent = TRUE)
rm(
  personal_df_raw,
  personal_df,
  partner_violence_risk_df,
  colnames_raw
)
```

## generated personal file (pgen)

```{r}
#| label: personal generated file load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# import
personal_gen_df_raw <- load_raw_df("pgen")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "pgisced11",
  # International Standard Classification of Education
  "pgstib" # occupational position
)

# transform
personal_gen_df <- personal_gen_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(pid, syear, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # transform scales
  mutate(
    education_level = pgisced11 %>%
      remap_values(
        0 ~ "in school",
        1 ~ "primary",
        2 ~ "secondary",
        3 ~ "secondary",
        4 ~ "Post-secondary non-tertiary",
        5 ~ "tertiary",
        6 ~ "tertiary",
        7 ~ "tertiary",
        8 ~ "tertiary"
      ),
    occupation_position = if_else(pgstib >= 100, floor(pgstib / 100), pgstib) %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "education/training",
        2 ~ "manual labour",
        3 ~ "manual labour",
        4 ~ "self-employed",
        5 ~ "employee",
        6 ~ "civil service",
        10 ~ "not employed",
        11 ~ "education/training",
        12 ~ "not employed",
        13 ~ "retired",
        14 ~ "retired",
        15 ~ "military/community service"
      )
  ) %>%
  # additional composite variables
  mutate(unemployed = case_when(
    occupation_position %in% c("not employed") ~ TRUE,
    is.na(occupation_position) ~ NA,
    TRUE ~ FALSE
  )) %>%
  # add static "data present" variable for tracking
  mutate(data_pgen = TRUE) %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# export & free memory
save_clean_df(personal_gen_df, "pgen")
rm(personal_gen_df_raw, personal_gen_df, colnames_raw)
```

## household file (hl)

```{r}
#| label: household file load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# import
household_df_raw <- load_raw_df("hl")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "hlf0135", # distance to city centre
  "hlc0021_h", # minimum income that would be enough for hh
  "hlf0001_h", # tenant/owner
  "hlf0291", # person requiring help in hh
  "hlf0153_h", # neighbourhood type
  "hlf0184", # is this a good neighbourhood
  "hlf0152", # residents know each other
  "hlf0149", # noise pollution
  "hlf0148", # air pollution
  "hlf0150", # too little green space
  "hlf0151" # feel safe
)

# transform
household_df <- household_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(hid, syear, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # transform scales
  ## household facts
  mutate(
    housing_status = hlf0001_h %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "main tenant",
        2 ~ "sub tenant",
        3 ~ "owner",
        4 ~ "nursing/retirement home",
        5 ~ "main tenant"
      ),
    income_min_sufficient = hlc0021_h %>%
      missing_to_na(),
    household_carework = hlf0291 %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE)
  ) %>%
  ## location & non-human neighbourhood factors
  mutate(
    distance_city_centre = hlf0135 %>%
      remap_values(
        6 ~ "60+ km",
        5 ~ "40 - 60 km",
        4 ~ "25 - 40 km",
        3 ~ "10 - 25 km",
        2 ~ "0 - 10 km",
        1 ~ "0 km",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    neighbourhood_type = hlf0153_h %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "residential area, old buildings",
        2 ~ "residential area, new buildings",
        3 ~ "mixed area, flats, houses and shops",
        4 ~ "commercial area",
        5 ~ "industrial area",
        6 ~ "other"
      ),
    neighbourhood_pollution_noise = hlf0149 %>%
      remap_values(
        5 ~ "very strong",
        4 ~ "strong",
        3 ~ "bearable",
        2 ~ "little",
        1 ~ "none",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    neighbourhood_pollution_air = hlf0148 %>%
      remap_values(
        5 ~ "very strong",
        4 ~ "strong",
        3 ~ "bearable",
        2 ~ "little",
        1 ~ "none",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      ),
    neighbourhood_greenspace_insufficient = hlf0150 %>%
      remap_values(
        5 ~ "very strong",
        4 ~ "strong",
        3 ~ "bearable",
        2 ~ "little",
        1 ~ "no",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  ## human neighbourhood factors
  mutate(
    neighbourhood_eval_good = hlf0184 %>%
      remap_values(1 ~ TRUE, 2 ~ FALSE),
    neighbourhood_cohesion = hlf0152 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "hardly know each other",
        2 ~ "talk occasionally",
        3 ~ "close bond",
        4 ~ "varied"
      ),
    neighbourhood_feel_safe = hlf0151 %>%
      remap_values(
        1 ~ "Very Safe",
        2 ~ "Relatively Safe",
        3 ~ "Relatively Unsafe",
        4 ~ "Very Unsafe",
        factor_ordered = TRUE
      )
  ) %>%
  # add static "data present" variable for tracking
  mutate(data_household = TRUE) %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# export & free memory
save_clean_df(household_df, "hl")
rm(household_df_raw, household_df, colnames_raw)
```

## household generated file (hgen)

```{r}
#| label: household generated file load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# import
household_gen_df_raw <- load_raw_df("hgen")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "hghinc", # net household income
  "hgmoveyr" # year moved into dwelling
)

# transform
household_gen_df <- household_gen_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(hid, syear, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # transform scales
  mutate(
    job_nr_household = NA, # adding later in 02_missingness
    income_net_household = hghinc %>%
      missing_to_na(),
    housing_moved_in_year = hgmoveyr %>%
      missing_to_na(),
  ) %>%
  # add static "data present" variable for tracking
  mutate(data_hgen = TRUE) %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# export & free memory
save_clean_df(household_gen_df, "hgen")
rm(household_gen_df_raw, household_gen_df, colnames_raw)
```

## household gross data (hbrutto)

```{r}
#| label: household gross file load & clean
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

# import
household_gross_df_raw <- load_raw_df("hbrutto")

# define names of raw variables
colnames_raw <- c(
  "hhgr" # household size
)

# transform
household_gross_df <- household_gross_df_raw %>%
  # select only relevant variables (helps with performance)
  select(hid, syear, all_of(colnames_raw)) %>%
  # transform scales
  mutate(
    household_size = hhgr %>%
      missing_to_na(),
    household_single = ifelse(household_size == 1,
      TRUE,
      FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  # add static "data present" variable for tracking
  mutate(data_hgross = TRUE) %>%
  # drop raw variables
  select(!all_of(colnames_raw))

# export & free memory
save_clean_df(household_gross_df, "hbrutto")
rm(household_gross_df_raw, household_gross_df, colnames_raw)
```

# Join

## index dataset

```{r}
#| label: load cleaned index dataset
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

merged_df <- load_clean_df("ppathl")
```

## personal file

```{r}
#| label: merge personal df
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

personal_df <- load_clean_df("pl")
partner_violence_risk_df <- load_clean_df("pvr")

merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  left_join(personal_df,
    by = join_by(pid, syear)
  ) %>%
  left_join(partner_violence_risk_df,
    by = join_by(parid == pid, syear)
  )

rm(
  personal_df,
  partner_violence_risk_df
)
```

## generated personal file

```{r}
#| label: merge personal generated df
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 10

personal_gen_df <- load_clean_df("pgen")

merged_df <- merged_df %>%
  left_join(personal_gen_df,
    by = join_by(pid, syear)
  )

rm(personal_gen_df)
```
